items.title: Harold Dejan Interview, 1963-03-29
items.q: I thought Alexander was playing alto

ctx.x: Well, when do you remember saxophone being introduced in the brass band?

Well, no, no, no, it's like I tell you, when Manner Perez was a brass band, that's the first time that I heard the saxophone with the brass band, because he always used a saxophone. Yeah, I thought Alexander was playing alto, and like I told you before, Eddie Sherry was playing E-flat clatter, sometimes he'd play tenor instead. Well that would say back in the twenties when they had the saxophone. Oh yeah, in the twenties, yeah, beginning of the twenties, low-hilly twenties. Well, yeah, I would say, I'd say in the…
Well, how does the brass band play that's different from jazz playing?
